title: GALA: Gallery-Level Alignment for Real-Life Vision Decoding from EEG
abstract: arXiv:2611.24206v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural decoding of visual experience from electroencephalography (EEG) has achieved strong performance in intra-subject settings, but current methods fail to generalize across individuals: on the standard 200-way benchmark THINGS-EEG-2, top-1 accuracy drops from above 80% within subjects to about 32% for an unseen subject. Adapting a pre-trained encoder to new subjects and sessions typically requires labeled data, a bottleneck whose collection time severely limits practical device deployment. In a practical Brain-Computer Interface (BCI), however, the possible outcomes are known in advance and form a gallery of candidates, and the unlabeled EEG of the user accumulates as soon as the device is used. We propose a new setting, incremental transductive calibration, in which the decoder is calibrated regularly on all the unlabeled EEG received so far and on the known gallery, without any labels. translated_title: GALA：面向真实场景EEG视觉解码的候选库级对齐方法
translated_abstract: 基于脑电图（EEG）的视觉体验神经解码在个体内设置中已取得优异性能，但现有方法无法跨个体泛化：在标准的200类基准THINGS-EEG-2上，top-1准确率从个体内的80%以上下降到未见过的个体仅约32%。将预训练编码器适配到新受试者和新会话通常需要标注数据，而其收集时间的瓶颈严重限制了设备的实际部署。然而，在实际的脑机接口（BCI）应用中，可能的结果是预先已知的，构成一个候选库，并且一旦设备投入使用，用户的未标注EEG数据便会持续累积。我们提出了一个新的设置——增量直推式校准，其中解码器定期在迄今为止收到的所有未标注EEG数据以及已知的候选库上进行校准，全程无需任何标签。这一设置更接近实际设备部署的真实条件……
tldr: 该论文提出GALA方法，并引入“增量直推式校准”新范式，利用预先已知的候选库和持续累积的未标注EEG数据进行无标签校准，从而解决EEG视觉解码难以跨个体泛化、依赖昂贵标注数据的瓶颈问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes GALA and a new setting of incremental transductive calibration, which enables label-free decoder calibration using a pre-known candidate gallery and continuously accumulated unlabeled EEG, addressing the poor cross-subject generalization and costly data annotation bottlenecks of EEG-based visual decoding.
